text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's because of the show I was watching…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aha, ha, hahaha! I can't! Every time I think about it, I just start laughing!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That episode was way more hilarious than usual too! It's keeping me up at night because I can't stop laughing about it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Phew… The masters of comedy… are a dangerous bunch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While it's good she enjoyed her day off, her lack of sleep proves to be a problem…
